PointCentralFubini.fpr_integral_add.importedStatement: Additivity of integration on lower semicontinuous maps.

PointCentralFubini.fpr_integral_iSup.importedStatement: Preservation of nonempty directed suprema in the integrand.

PointCentralFubini.fpr_functional_unique.reference: FPR Theorem 3.5 and its uniqueness argument
PointCentralFubini.fpr_functional_unique.importedStatement: Linear Scott continuous functionals are determined by open indicators.

PointCentralFubini.heckmann_approximatio.importedStatement: Directed bounded approximation for continuous and point-continuous valuations.

PointCentralFubini.jlmz_open_fubini.reference: JLMZ Theorem 21, extended version PDF page 9
PointCentralFubini.jlmz_open_fubini.importedStatement: Open-set subprobability Fubini with one point-continuous valuation. Arbitrary-mass extension proved in Lean.

PointCentralFubini.deBrechtKawai_coconso.reference: de Brecht and Kawai 2019 Proposition 7.2, printed page 13:15
PointCentralFubini.deBrechtKawai_coconso.importedStatement: Co-consonance of the Scott open lattice of a countably based space.

PointCentralFubini.xuYang_sorgenfrey_sco.reference: Xu and Yang Theorem 5.8 and Example 5.18(4)
PointCentralFubini.xuYang_sorgenfrey_sco.importedStatement: Scott topology equals the upper Vietoris topology for Sorgenfrey compacta.

PointCentralFubini.fpr_measure_integral.importedStatement: Agreement of the measure and valuation integrals on lower semicontinuous maps.

PointCentralFubini.ajk_compact_ordered_e.reference: Alvarez-Manilla, Jung and Keimel, Theorem 27, printed page 16; author-hosted corrected version dated 11 May 2020
PointCentralFubini.ajk_compact_ordered_e.importedStatement: Existence clause: a bounded continuous valuation on the upward topology of a compact ordered space extends to a finite Radon measure on its Hausdorff topology. Radon means inner regular on all Borel sets. Tau-smoothness is proved internally.

PointCentralFubini.xuYang_sorgenfrey_dcp.reference: Xu and Yang Lemma 3.1 and Example 5.18
PointCentralFubini.xuYang_sorgenfrey_dcp.importedStatement: Nonempty Sorgenfrey compact subsets form a dcpo under reverse inclusion.
PointCentralFubini.xuYang_sorgenfrey_dcp.proofMethod: Cantor intersection theorem for nonempty compact Hausdorff sets; generic reverse-inclusion dcpo proof.
